walkthroughs.title: Harden the gateway, one switch at a time
walkthroughs.say: Start at the seeded gateway and use the switches the deck names. The scorecard rises with each. It stops short of twelve because this model has no switch for network mode.

checks.name: Authorizer
checks.rule: a JWT authorizer is configured

checks.name: Audience pinning
checks.rule: allowed audiences are listed and none is a wildcard

checks.name: Enforcement
checks.rule: the policy engine is in ENFORCE, not LOG_ONLY
checks.why: the policy engine is in ENFORCE

checks.name: Policy scope
checks.rule: at least one policy is attached to the engine

checks.name: Enforcement health
checks.rule: the policy engine is ACTIVE

checks.name: Caller pinning
checks.rule: the gateway endpoint is pinned (the lab's reading of "caller pinning")

checks.name: Throttling
checks.rule: a rate limit is set

checks.name: WAF
checks.rule: the WAF fails closed

checks.name: Egress privacy
checks.rule: egress is private

checks.name: Content checks
checks.rule: content checks are on

checks.name: Bypass closed
checks.rule: no runtime can be called around the gateway
checks.why: no runtime can be called around the gateway

checks.name: Network paths
checks.rule: every runtime is on a private network

walkthroughs.title: Enforcing needs the typed name
walkthroughs.say: Flipping from log-only to enforcing is refused without the gateway's name, refused with a wrong one, and nothing changes until the right text is typed.

steps.detail: the typed confirmation does not match the gateway name; nothing changed
the typed confirmation does not match the gateway name; nothing changed
